description: This file manages webhooks scheduling, subscription management, and related booking operations for a calendar or booking system, including handling of no-show tasks and out-of-office entries.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Creates a new webhook subscription, schedules jobs for existing bookings if trigger is for meeting start/end.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Deletes a webhook subscription based on webhook ID and app context.

methods.name: listBookings
methods.description: Retrieves a list of upcoming bookings, enriched with additional info.

methods.name: scheduleTrigger
methods.description: Schedules a webhook trigger for a booking at the appropriate time.

methods.name: updateTriggerForExistingBookings
methods.description: Updates triggers for existing bookings based on trigger changes, scheduling or canceling as needed.

methods.name: listOOOEntries
methods.description: Lists out-of-office entries for a user or team.

methods.name: cancelNoShowTasksForBooking
methods.description: Cancels scheduled no-show tasks for a specific booking or webhook.

methods.name: scheduleNoShowTaskForBooking
methods.description: Schedules a no-show webhook task for a booking at a specified time.

methods.name: _deleteWebhookScheduledTriggers
methods.description: Internal function to delete scheduled webhook triggers based on various criteria.
